events.title: Next Fest is on. The EdNoKa demo is free.
events.summary: Next Fest is on until October 26, so this is basically the week to try EdNoKa. Pick a quiz, pick a game. Answer right and it rains on your crops, your golf ball gets an extra stroke, fewer missiles chase you. Answer wrong and nothing ends. The missiles just get a bit more motivated. It plays in English or French, no chat, no ads. A recording of our family playing it runs on the store page all week, if you want to see it first. events.title: Watch our family play EdNoKa (recorded) all Next Fest
events.summary: During Next Fest this page plays a recording of our son going through the EdNoKa demo. It's recorded, not live. If you miss a good answer, just wait, it comes back. He does multiplication while dodging missiles, world flags on the golf course, dinosaurs, then switches the whole game to French and keeps going. The camera only shows his hands on the keyboard. The demo is free on this page, for ages 8 to 11. Questions? Ask in the discussions, we answer every post.

events.title: The EdNoKa demo now speaks French
events.summary: Basically, the free demo is now in French. Menus, games, the demo quizzes, all of it. To switch, click the globe icon on the main menu. We live in Montreal and our son goes to school in French, so I figured it was time. While translating I learned that a manchot and a pingouin are not the same bird. The game knew before me. The rest of the quizzes get their French for the full release on December 17. If a sentence sounds weird in French, tell us in the discussions. Enjoy! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4533

events.title: Meet the Parent Hub
events.summary: Ever ask your kid "how was the game?" and get "good"? Same here. That's why we made the Parent Hub. The Parent Hub It shows which quizzes got played and how they went. It's right there on the same computer, no extra account, nothing sent anywhere. No timers, no nagging, no comparing kids. It's in the full game (no DLC needed), so it's ready the moment you install. events.title: Five games, five different ways a right answer pays off
events.summary: The demo has been out two weeks, so here is what is actually in it. All five games are in the demo, not a sample of them. What changes between them is what a correct answer buys you. Veggies Island. Gather, trade for seeds, grow your patch. Correct answers make it rain, and rain is what grows the crop. Pico Golf. Underwater mini golf across ten holes. events.title: The demo is out. Go play it.
events.summary: We pressed the button. The EdNoKa demo is live on Steam, it is free, and the download button is right on this page. What it is Five mini-games where the quiz is part of the play, not a screen that interrupts it. Farm, golf, investigate, fight or fly your way through a set of questions. Answer right and your crop grows, your shot lands, your cover holds.
